title: My Project
text:
Developed a full-stack web platform where users can browse and purchase shoes, while staff manage inventory through an admin dashboard.

Built backend using Django framework

Integrated MySQL database with Django ORM

Implemented product management and order system

Designed admin dashboard for inventory control





Created an intelligent waste classification platform that automatically identifies trash types from uploaded images.

Used CNN deep learning models (MobileNetV2 & ResNet50)

Achieved 93.88% accuracy with MobileNetV2

Built a web interface for image uploads and predictions

Combined AI system with IoT-based data flow





Developed a machine learning system to predict house rental prices.

Collected and cleaned 20,000+ rental records

Trained ML models for price prediction

Built visualizations to analyze trends and patterns





Designed a mathematical model to analyze and predict internet performance across campus.

Modeled network performance using mathematical techniques

Identified fastest network zones

Helped optimize service usage and planning
